name: Factor Bikes
verdict: Factor Bikes has been led by CEO Rob Gitelis since about 2016; in 2025 Zhonglu Co's subsidiary took 21.15% and VSI Cycling 31.72% — a joint majority. Nothing found.
note: High-end carbon bike maker (factories in Taichung, Taiwan and China); bike partner and sleeve sponsor of the 2026 kit. No single controlling owner is documented: VSI Cycling Limited (31.72%) and Zhonglu Advantage Global Investment (21.15%, part of Shanghai-listed Zhonglu Co) jointly bought a majority in 2025, with CEO Rob Gitelis among the investors. Zhonglu is a private Chinese listed company; no state control documented and no human-rights finding found.
